campaign.title: M1 D=1 full Abel commutator recombination gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: Audit fractional-part Fourier, exponent-pair, Poisson or B-process, incomplete quadratic, and character-sum theorems only against the exact common-profile variable residual-mask scalar. Record truncation, moving endpoints, coefficient variation, character twist, modulus and interval ranges, all exceptional modes, and every restored N-M-V power.

frozen_target.question: Does exact recombination of the moving trace, both profile-difference remainders, and both outer endpoints restore a single common-profile selected residual-mask sum for the full paired-interior D=d=L=1 matrix, and can that exact combined scalar be proved target-sized or on a strict owner-complete range; if not, what is the first non-telescoping, variable-mask, coefficient, Fourier, truncation, source, or restored-power obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Retain B_j(x)=1_(x>=1)1_(-x<=j<=x-1)w_U((x^2-j)/N)e(sqrt(x^2-j)-x), every odd d|N, every interior v mod H, both signed j blocks, and all six sign-adapted Abel lines. Recombine before estimation. Complete-frequency inversion gives S_U(V)=sum_(V<|j|<=2V)sum_x B_j(x)G_N(x^2-j). The candidate selected compression is sum_(ell>=1)chi_4(ell)w_U(ell)e(sqrt(N ell))1_(V<|kappa(ell)^2-N ell|<=2V), with kappa(ell)=floor(sqrt(N ell)+1/2). The scalar target is X^epsilon, equivalently raw M^(3/4)X^epsilon.
quantities: Retain the positive right and negative left Abel outer endpoints, both moving atoms, both profile-difference remainders, every component transition, zero extension, half-open choice, and hard dyadic endpoint.
Prove the finite reconstruction separately on each sign block and for every d and v before complete-frequency inversion.
Retain arbitrary N, every odd d|N, c=4N/d, H=c/2, both complementary representatives, and c=4.
Subtract the already closed zero and Nyquist whole rows exactly once; do not transfer their theorems to Abel pieces.
Audit the physical-lift multiplicity and the nearest-cell partition before replacing x and j by kappa(ell) and r(ell).
Distinguish the full quotient profile w_U(ell) from both isolated-trace boundary profiles; no isolated-trace statement is retroactively altered.
Use e(sqrt(N ell)-kappa(ell))=e(sqrt(N ell)) only because kappa(ell) is integral.
Treat the exact defect mask as the variable band r=-delta(2kappa+delta); no fixed endpoint may replace it without a proved error.
Treat min(M,V) as support cardinality only and restore the M^(-3/4) atom scale before claiming the scalar target.

Any new analytic range must lie on the currently open side M^449<<R^780, with R=X^(1/4) and N=floor(X), and must extend beyond the already owned fixed-polylogarithmic defect collar; the known M^449>>R^780 TTY/BD range is not a new gain.
No result transfers to D>1, L>1, generic t=1, t>=2, cross, another M1 or M2 owner, endpoint uniformity, M9, bridge, target, or exponent owners.

completion_criteria: Independently rederive the exact positive and negative finite Abel reconstructions with all six lines, signs, transitions, and endpoints.
Prove or refute the exact common-profile selected-coordinate compression of the full physical row.
Audit subtraction of the zero and Nyquist whole rows exactly once and restore the full paired-interior normalization.
Calibrate the scalar X^epsilon target and raw M^(3/4) target, including the external scalar seam.

On the open side M^449<<R^780, prove the common-profile residual-mask scalar target, isolate a strict owner-complete range beyond the accepted collar, or identify the first exact variable-mask, Fourier, truncation, coefficient, source, or restored-power obstruction.
Source-audit every imported Fourier-band, exponent-pair, Poisson, incomplete-quadratic, or character-sum theorem against the literal scalar.
Close under exactly one label: paired_interior_abel_commutator_target, strict_profile_commutator_range, or paired_interior_abel_commutator_no_go.
